attempts.summary: Locked the curl package version on node1 using dnf versionlock (curl-0:8.12.1-4.el10.*), verified it is excluded from update transactions while unrelated packages (e.g. libcurl) still update normally, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured a healthy baseline, issued a native systemctl reboot, confirmed the node went unreachable and came back, proved the boot_id changed (83a0a80f... -> 0f15c938...), and reverified post-reboot that curl is still locked at its original version, the system is healthy (systemctl is-system-running: running), and a dry-run update still excludes curl.
